job.job_title: Senior AI Engineer OpenAI / LLM / Agent Development
job.job_description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy LLM-powered AI agents for RevOps and enterprise automation. This role involves working with OpenAI and Google stacks, building scalable AI systems, and integrating them with enterprise platforms.





Key Responsibilities

Design and develop AI agents end-to-end using OpenAI APIs
Implement multi-step agent workflows, prompt logic, and tool integrations
Build integrations with Salesforce, Marketo, Outreach, Snowflake (or similar systems)
Develop RAG-based systems using embeddings and vector search
Work on prompt engineering, function calling, and AI orchestration frameworks
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deploy AI systems into production
Perform testing, debugging, and monitoring of AI applications
Support UAT, deployment, and post-production optimization




Required Skills

Strong experience with OpenAI APIs (GPT, embeddings, function calling)
Hands-on experience building AI agents / LLM applications
Experience with Python and REST APIs
Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector databases
Experience with LangChain / LlamaIndex (or similar)
Experience integrating AI with enterprise tools (CRM, marketing automation, etc.)
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills




Good to Have

Experience with Google Vertex AI / Gemini
Experience with Salesforce or RevOps systems
Prior experience in client-facing delivery roles
